missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Родитель' is nominative as the subject of 'любит'. 'Каждый' is the agreeing masculine determiner, and 'детей' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Родителя' is the accusative of this animate masculine noun, matching the genitive ending. 'Своего' agrees as the reflexive possessive.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Родителя' is genitive showing whose advice it is. 'Одного' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'совет' is nominative.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. 'Родителям' is the dative plural required by 'звоню', which governs the dative. 'Часто' adds the frequency.
Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Родителем' is instrumental after 'стал' to mark the resulting role. 'Хорошим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Родителях' is the prepositional plural after 'о' to give the topic. 'Моих' agrees in the plural prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Родители' is the nominative plural subject of 'ждут'. 'Детей' is the accusative object and 'дома' marks location.

missions.phrase: Я еду к родителям на выходные.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Родителям' is dative plural after 'к' to show movement toward people. 'На выходные' gives the timeframe.
Strategic focus: Genitive in possession frame. 'Родителя' is genitive after 'у' to show the owner. 'Моего' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'машина' is nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Родителями' is instrumental plural after 'с' to mean living together with them. A common everyday statement.
